reviews.author: J Butler
reviews.text: I noticed some water stains on the ceiling of our bonus room and found On Tops through a quick search. Prior reviews were positive, so I put in an online request for a quote. Jonathan called the next day to schedule a time to come out. He was out the following day and his crew was out within a couple days to do the repair.

reviews.author: Ronna Hearne
reviews.text: This company is outstanding! I would recommend this company to anyone who needs a roof. Josh came out to our house and gave us a quote and was very thorough in explaining the process and requirements for the type of roof we have. The day of the new roof install, the crew got there on time and immediately got to work, keeping the area around the house covered and clean through out the day. They missed nothing during the cleanup process. Extremely happy with the process and our new roof looks amazing!

reviews.author: fiveboyces
reviews.text: Absolutely amazing company to deal with from start to finish. Responsive, prompt and professional. Sales department is spot on, they answered questions we didn’t even think of through their presentation. The crew and on site was amazing as well showed up to the site exactly when they said, got the job done with a high attention to detail. No surprises and clean up was perfect. Follow up and close out was just as professional and timely. I’d recommend them to anyone looking to invest in their home with a new roof.

reviews.author: Adrian Collins
reviews.text: On Tops Roofing has been fantastic from start to finish. We had some winter weather damage from an ice dam that caused a leak in our garage. Jonathan was our first point of contact and dealt with the process with a level of grace, understanding, and patience that gave us reassurance. We felt comfortable with them largely because of his demeanor and Arturo was great during the install and after. Part of the difficulty in finding a service provider is establishing trust through integrity of interactions. On Tops definitely made us feel comfortable trusting them and they delivered.

reviews.author: Georgia Patterson
reviews.text: I had an excellent experience from start to finish. They were professional, punctual, and paid great attention to detail. The quality of the work exceeded my expectations, and the roof looks fantastic. Cleanup was thorough, and the entire process was smooth and stress-free. Highly recommend for anyone needing roofing work! They did a phenomenal job!

reviews.author: Laura Jacobsen
reviews.text: We couldn’t be more pleased with On Tops Roofing. We had complete roofing done on a house roof with many slopes, a detached garage, and a small barn, each with their own challenges! Our company rep, Jonathan, was very patient with our concerns, explained thoroughly every process and the materials they would use, and gave us a thorough emailed quote with every detail. Jonathan came out every day to check on the progress and crew, and identified any potential concerns. Arturo, a top supervisor stopped several times to check on progress. Daeus was the onsite supervisor and Fidel was the crew chief. Hats off to them & the entire crew for making the process seamless! On Tops is local, and has regular crews who have worked together for years, with guaranteed workmanship and materials. They worked like a machine! Clean up was thorough, and Jonathan made a final stop to assure us that if there was any concern in 2 days, 2 months, or 2 years to call him. We highly recommend On Tops Roofing for doing business the right way, and truly putting the customer first.

reviews.author: ray de costa
reviews.text: Amazing job, well done, highly recommended. We had a full roof replacement done. The team arrived first thing in the morning and worked a long day. They were back the next day and finished the entire project by afternoon (old roof 1 day, new the next). The crew was knowledgeable and efficient. They moved everything away from the house that was in harms way and replaced all when done. We worked with Josh to get quotes and suggestions. He is personable and was very helpful and responded to all our questions/texts.

reviews.author: Rhonda Brown
reviews.text: On Tops replaced my roof about 12 years ago and done a fantastic job. Recently we noticed a “growth” under the shingles. I called Jonathan who helped me originally. Explained that we seen and sent him photos. He told me exactly what it was and what it took to fix it cost and all in 1 phone call. My quote was emailed within a few hours. Once signed I was scheduled. The crew came spent about an hour to hour and half problem fixed. Very happy with them and definitely recommend them for roofing needs!

reviews.author: Thomas Spero
reviews.text: I recently contacted On Tops Roofing for a small roof leak and I could not be more impressed with the entire experience from start to finish. From my initial outreach through the repair and final payment, the communication was absolutely outstanding, responsive, clear, and professional at every step. That alone sets them apart from other contractors I've dealt with. What really impressed me was their thoroughness during the inspection. Not only did they fix the leak I called about, but they took the time to walk me through the overall condition of my 10-year-old roof and backed everything up with photos. They identified several issues that would have become serious problems down the road, including deteriorating boots around the vents, wear on the roof cap, and exposed rusted nails. Having that visual evidence gave me complete confidence that their recommendations were legitimate and not just upselling (pictures to prove it). They were honest and transparent, and they clearly took pride in their work. I now have peace of mind knowing the full condition of my roof and a plan to address the remaining issues before they become costly repairs. I highly recommend On Tops Roofing.

reviews.author: Nick Wallace
reviews.text: Jonathan was great! Josh and his crew were great! The roof looks amazing. The price was fair. I would definitely recommend On Tops to anyone in need of roofing work!

reviews.author: Tim Day
reviews.text: Extremely pleased with overall professionalism, work quality and communication throughout the entire process. We would highly recommend On Tops Roofing for repair needs. Great job!!!

reviews.author: Brett Moore
reviews.text: Team showed up during the scheduled time and worked very swiftly replacing my roof. They cut it close with darkness falling but they got the job done and a rep came out the next day to make sure the cleanup was completed. Only negative thing, they took a couple days to send us the bill. Highly recommend using them here in the Goldsboro area. House looks amazing.

reviews.author: Stephen Moore
reviews.text: Fantastic company. Chris returned my call within minutes for shingle/roofing problem. Someone was sent out a few hours later and problem was fixed within 36 hours. Fast, expert , courteous service. This was a wonderful experience. Their knowledge and professionalism set my mind at ease. You will not be disappointed, I promise!

reviews.author: Carol Vroom
reviews.text: Working with on Tops Roofing was a great experience from beginning to end. Out of 3 estimates Jonathan was the only one who actually looked inside the chimney. He explained exactly what needed done to stop the leak and even instructed me on why each of the ceiling stains occurred and how I could fix them. The office staff were kind and helpful and the repair was done quickly and smoothly. They even cleaned up everything after. I’d highly recommend them if you need any roof work done.

reviews.author: Tina K.
reviews.text: This is the second time we have used this company. Jonathan, Lexi, Aurturo, are all great to work with. Their workmanship is beautiful and they care about their clients. Wouldn't hesitate to recommend them or call on them again!

reviews.author: Janice Schoew
reviews.text: This company is professional, prompt and knowledgeable. I was very pleased with the roof they installed and the workers were not only skilled but cleaned up after themselves. I highly recommend On Tops Roofing.

reviews.author: Jon Hall
reviews.text: I reached out to On Top Roofing to have a few shingles replaced as I’m in the process of selling my home. I was able to speak with Jonathan and he was very kind and understanding of my needs. He was able to get his team over to my home and repair the shingles in just a few days as they were super busy before thanksgiving. He knew I was under a time crunch to get the repairs and worked diligently to get me scheduled before the holidays. The team that showed up to do the repairs were also very kind and professional. They were able to get the repairs done very quickly and provided before and after pictures to show a job well done. I highly recommend On Top Roofing.

reviews.author: Joshua Morehead
reviews.text: Excellent crew, very professional from start to finish! hats off to Josh, Arturo & Daeus were all super helpful. If you are in Fayetteville I highly recommend!

reviews.author: SHALEA adams
reviews.text: Metal Roof on Bunkie Life Summer Cabin: They were absolutely amazing! Totally professional, clearly laid out a schedule, timely communication, cleaned up after themselves. You really couldn’t ask for better! And did I mention polite as well?

reviews.author: Hannah Warren
reviews.text: Professional, quick, and polite! Beautiful work. They did a full roof replacement for me in just a day. The entire experience from start to finish was wonderful. Highly recommend!!

reviews.author: Marcie Smith
reviews.text: Polite snd professional staff from beginning to end. The roofing of our shed was done in 2.5 hours It looks great! No nails or trash was left. Price was very reasonable in comparison to other companies We highly recommend!

reviews.author: Garry High
reviews.text: Worked with Jonathan after snow blew in ridge vents. He didn’t recommend the most expensive approach but just a general maintenance and tighten up of vents. Guys came out on a Saturday and were fast, efficient and professional. Did an excellent job.

reviews.author: Greg Egan
reviews.text: This company was recommended to me by a neighbor and I'm happy they did. They were hear on time and finished in a day. Left no trash or nails. The new roof looks great.

reviews.author: D Hollinger (Dee)
reviews.text: I just cannnot say enough about this company so here's the story! They put a new roof on our house some years ago and since then, every time I've called with a roof question or a possible leak issue, they have responded so fast. I have been working with Jonathan since day one, so he calls me right away to say when he'll be here. The year were had that big hail storm he came out to see if we had any damage. Luckily, we did not. If i have a roof question or suspect a leak (water will find a way), he calls me back right away and shows up soon thereafter to check it out. Last week, we saw what looked to be a water spot in the kitchen. Jonathan was here and up in the attic before we knew it to assess the situation. The range hood vent that was not being used had to come out and maintenance on the seals was needed. The On Tops crew was here the same week making the necessary fixes. Arturo texted me he was on the way. They are a very efficient and professional group of guys. Even though last week was like the 3rd time Jonathan was here, he makes us feel comfortable with his knowledge and genuine concern. All this is why they will forever be TOPS for our roofing needs! Smile. Thanks yall!

reviews.author: Benny Myatt
reviews.text: I have been a customer for over a decade as I own multiple properties. That should speak for itself with my satisfaction. Prompt, excellent communications and quality work and clean-up

reviews.author: Ian Sorsch
reviews.text: On Tops Roofing recently installed a new roof on my home, and I couldn’t be happier with the results. The shingle color is perfect, it matches my home’s exterior color scheme so well it looks like it was made specifically for my house. The curb appeal is incredible. The crew was friendly, efficient, and fully professional from start to finish. They arrived exactly when they said they would and completed the entire roof the same day. They cleaned up everything afterward and left my property looking even better than when they arrived. A special shout-out to Josh Moore, the project manager. He was extremely knowledgeable, professional, and kept me informed every step of the way. 5 stars, hands down. I’ll be recommending On Tops Roofing to everyone I know who needs a new roof. Look no further, this is the company you want.

reviews.author: Carolyn
reviews.text: Fast response, wonderful staff. Jonathan thoroughly explained what was needed. I had a complicated roofline and some tight spaces and they had no problems doing an incredible job. This is the second time I have used them and would recommend them to my neighbors.

reviews.author: Marc Powell
reviews.text: On Tops Roofing installed our roof last week. From Jonathan during the estimate, through Josh and Arturo during the install, things proceeded like clockwork. The entire crew was friendly, curteous, and worked well together. They worked from dusk to dawn to deliver a quality installation. We were in Cary this week and decided to drop off the payment at their office. Jennifer and Lexi were very friendly, professional. They took the time to answer our questions. I was surprised when we received our bill. It was below the estimate! This was our second time calling on On Tops. I recommend them to anyone who is looking a great, dependable roofing company at a fair price.

reviews.author: Jason Toussaint
reviews.text: The great people at On Tops truly understand the meaning of their name. They were on top of everything! Within a day of submitting a request for a quote, I received a callback and an appointment was set. Arturo had taken the pics and I received a quote within 2 days. An although it took me some time to okay the work(argument with the builder about the shotty work they did)soon I called to authorize, an email of contract was sent. Amazingly, there was no change in pricing. That was a welcome surprise. I was told it would be about a week before the job would be done. To my surprise, Arturo was there within 2 days, and completed the job in 4 hours. He did any AMAZING job!!! We couldn't be happier. Everyone that I have spoken to at On Tops was genuinely patience and caring to make this a seamless experience....And it was! Thank you so much!

reviews.author: Lindsey Glickfeld
reviews.text: Jonathan, Josh and the whole crew were fantastic. From getting the quote to scheduling the job to cleaning it up, everyone was helpful, communicative and professional. And the new roof looks great.

reviews.author: Donnie Parker
reviews.text: Service was great! Jonathan came out and estimated the price for what he thought should be done on my roof leak. Arturo informed me know when the work could be completed. Oscar came out and repaired the roof quickly. All this took place within a few days from me requesting an estimate. The work was greatly appreciated! Thank you

reviews.author: Alfonso MAROTTA
reviews.text: Excellent work done! Received a new roof yesterday and everything went very smoothly. Workers did an extraordinary job and the staff was superb

reviews.author: mae jernigan
reviews.text: Replaced 3 skylights on my house. Workers showed up on time and work was completed on time. Very satisfied with completed job and would highly recommend On Top Roofing.

reviews.author: Lawrence Ray
reviews.text: Unfortunately, we have experienced a leaking roof twice in recent years. Both times, we've called on On Tops to assess damage and make the needed repairs. On Tops has always responded quickly when contacted. Their follow-up assessments have been thorough, and they provided a very clear explanation (with photot) of what the problem was (or might be). The Roofing work, and the cleanup, were performed quickly and professionally. We have been very satisfied with each phase of our roof repair process and highly recommend On Tops!

reviews.author: Bertrand Wilder
reviews.text: On Tops Roofing supplied a detailed quote. They explained the problem and provided a repair and a replacement option. The day of installation they were on time replaced need plywood. They took plenty of pictures to show us the issues and the final product. They are professional and have excellent customer service.

reviews.author: Brittany Barbour
reviews.text: We recently had a new roof installed on both our house and shop, and we couldn't be more thrilled with the outstanding job this company did. From start to finish, they were professional, reliable, and dedicated to their work. They showed up on time, worked late into the day, and even completed the entire project in less than 2 days! It was especially impressive how they handled the extreme heat on the day of the installation. You can tell this company truly cares about their employees, they took steps to ensure the team stayed cool and healthy throughout the day. This level of care and dedication speaks volumes about the company's integrity and the quality of their workers. The administrative staff and project managers were incredibly knowledgeable and helpful, making the entire process seamless for us. They provided all the information we needed, and we felt completely confident every step of the way. We absolutely love our new roof and highly recommend this roofing company to anyone looking for top-notch service. A big thank you to the entire team for an excellent experience!

reviews.author: Kenneth Shea
reviews.text: On Tops did a great job replacing our roof recently. They completed the whole job in one day and made sure to clean up everything. The reason that we choose On Tops was for their customer service and communication through the whole process. We looked at other vendors with similar price points, but On Tops did a much better job at getting us a detailed quote real fast - and then they delivered as expected. We had our new roof completed within one week of signing the quote.

reviews.author: Erich Horner
reviews.text: If you are looking for a roofing company look no further. I started with a relationship with Jonathan Kennedy on the sales team. He was fantastic, knowledgeable, never pushy, and truly gave advice that was most specific to my needs. Then when it came time to the project being done, Josh Moore and his team did an excellent job and worked quickly, even in the extreme heat. With two little kids that love to be outside, I was extremely appreciative of the thoroughness of the cleanup afterwards as well. My only negative criticism is that they left our back yard gate open, so later that day when we let the dogs out and assumed it was closed like usual, they escaped. We were able to track them down so no harm no foul but could have been worse. Overall, superb work was done and the communication was top notch. 10/10 highly recommend.

reviews.author: Amelie Gallant
reviews.text: These guys did a FANTASTIC job on our roof. They took down the old shingles, replaced them with new ones and cleaned up in 8h. Super friendly as well. I had absolutely no knowledge about roofs before our first appointment with Jonathan, but he did a great job at explaining every step. Josh as well did a great job at communicating with us throughout the whole process. Very smooth experience from start to finish! 100% recommendation

reviews.author: Shirley Stankus
reviews.text: The personnel of On Tops Roofing are excellent. Chris (the owner) is exceptionally professional and communication is always prompt. His staff including Arturo are also friendly and professional and work is exceptional. I appreciate that Chris sends photos of work needed and completed! I would recommend this company highly!

reviews.author: Gregory Doherty
reviews.text: Our entire experience with On Tops was exceptional. Clearly, everyone associated with On Tops takes pride in their jobs. From our initial contact with Jennifer and Jonathan, to the roof inspection by Arturo and the the roofing crew with Josh, everyone was professional and personable. It was a pleasure to deal with a company that does what they say they will do and keeps appointments and schedules. The clean up around the house when the job was done was impeccable. We would certainly recommend On Tops to anyone needing roof repair and or replacement.

reviews.author: Aaron Costello
reviews.text: On Tops Roofing had been a pleasure to work with, from start to finish. They stand behind their work, have great communication, and customer service. For example, I called OTR this morning for a lifting shingle from an install done 8 years ago. Johnathan was prompt and had one of his workers at my home with this repair made in less than 2 hours! The best experience I've ever had with a roofing company has been with On Tops Roofing! Thanks you for taking care of a life long customer!

reviews.author: N White
reviews.text: Great response, personable service, timely work completion and over all wonderful experience. Will keep on hand for all our future roofing needs.

reviews.author: Dan and Melanie Smith
reviews.text: On Tops Roofing did a great job on my roof replacement and was super easy to work with. Jonathan and Josh were closely involved in the entire project. Highly recommend!!

reviews.author: Cranki
reviews.text: Called on a Monday, said they would do Estimate on Tuesday. I had the estimate within a couple hours. Came following Wednesday and completed the roof in 1 day.

reviews.author: Jason Duchin
reviews.text: One of the great joys as a home owner is working with folks who treat your home as though it was their own. Ontops roofing was a wonderful experience. They came in on time and on budget and were a pleasure to work with. Our home had a 20+ year old leaky roof and Ontops left us in great shape with the promise of a dry roof for the next 25+ years. I could not more strongly recommend this company to other home owners. They rock.

reviews.author: Eberhard Link
reviews.text: good customer service, attentive, simple free quote, and the invoice matched the quote. Repair service was done on time, with completion pictures after the job was done. Can only recommend this company.

reviews.author: David Murray
reviews.text: I was very pleased with the service received from On Top. It was a small repair job but handled very timely.

reviews.author: Cheri Pepicello
reviews.text: We are so very grateful to On Tops Roofing for coming out to our home the day before the nasty rains came down to prevent further damage. After the storms had passed they then returned and fixed everything they had to. I actually spoke to the roofer and he was so polite and did an awesome job of fixing our roof and picking up all the debris. We definitely recommend On Tops Roofing to anyone who needs a company that responds quickly and does a fantastic job! THANK YOU On Tops Roofing!

reviews.author: David Whitaker
reviews.text: The On Tops Roofing team was a pleasure to work with on our large project. They explained all aspects of the work in great detail and kept us continually informed on the work status. They completed the work ahead of schedule and did a superb job in cleaning the area after the work was performed. Every member of the crew provided us a high level of quality and workmanship. Their pricing was very fair and reasonable. We would definitely use On Tops again for future roofing replacements.

reviews.author: Amy Krieger
reviews.text: The team showed up on time and did an excellent job on the repai to my roof. Would highly recommend.

reviews.author: Lorena Handschu
reviews.text: Im pleased with the service from onTopsRoofing. Jonathan provided an estimate for a window leak, Arturo worked with the crew to get the job done. There has not been a strong rain since the fix, but both Jonathan and Arturo were confident the fix will take care of the leak, that gave me peace of mind. Thank you so much!!

reviews.author: Frank Grzesik
reviews.text: Highly recommend on tops! They were professional and easy to work with. The new roof looks great. Will definitely use them again!!

reviews.author: Joy Bouquin
reviews.text: We could not have asked for a better experience with On Tops Roofing. After extensive research of several roofing companies, we decided with On Tops Roofing because they are a local company, pricing was fair, great warranty, and wonderful customer service. Chris was amazing. He was always very responsive to our phone calls and helpful with any questions we had. Luis, our project manager, was very polite and professional and did a wonderful job keeping us informed throughout the entire process. He and his crew were very efficient and did a great job from roof removal to clean up. We are so pleased with our experience and love our new roof! A big thank you to the entire On Tops Roofing team!

reviews.author: Verdawn Johnson
reviews.text: Very professional from the beginning to the end. Very fast, done a perfect job. Des and Jonathan were very professional and answered all questions.

reviews.author: Taylor Reed
reviews.text: Great quality work and good people. Highly recommend! They replaced our lower roof in one afternoon and did a great job. I was also impressed how well they cleaned up considering we have young kids.and a dog.

reviews.author: Drew D
reviews.text: On top roofing did a phenomenal job. Great customer service from sales manager Jonathan, down to office manager and installers!! The roof was able to be repaired, and they didn't try to sell me a replacement like some companies do. They even offered to tarp the area until they could schedule incase of rain. But that wasn't needed because they were back out in 4 days. Definitely recommend and will use them again.

reviews.author: Matthew Henderson
reviews.text: Josh and the team were quick to take care of our needs following the snow storm! Top notch service all around.

reviews.author: Rick Helton
reviews.text: Chris Talton of On Tops Roofing did a complete reroof for us. Excellent work!! They did everything they said they were going to do and the job looks great. Thanks so much. Luis was the site manager and was there the whole time giving me updates and answering any questions I had. Top notch company.

reviews.author: Shannon Cox
reviews.text: On Top Roofing was everything I wanted in a roofing company. They were professional, courteous, friendly, and hard working. They were efficient without cutting corners. I was especially pleased with the care that the entire team took to protect my property, plants, and porches. Josh was our Project Manager and from start to finish he told me what was happening every step of the way. I could go on and on about how great this company is. They did NOT pay me for this review. I’m simply trying to help others who are looking for great quality work from honest people. This is the company!

reviews.author: Debbie Shelton
reviews.text: We would highly recommend On Tops Roofing! We could not have asked for a better experience from start to finish. Chris was great to work with and explained the process with us concisely and provided a very clear proposal. The office staff was always helpful and the project manager, Luis and his crew were excellent! Their attention to detail and hard work are second to none! We love our new roof!

reviews.author: Maria Crammer
reviews.text: I would highly recommend On Tops Roofing. I recently had a leak in our roof after heavy rain. I called and got an immediate response from Jonathan. He sent Arturo out for an inspection and received quote later that day. I felt the price was fair and was able to have the roof repaired the very next day. Excellent communication and workmanship.

reviews.author: Ross Poole
reviews.text: After soliciting 6 or so quotes for my roof replacement I chose On Tops because of their reputation and my experience with the sales rep - Chris. Chris knew his roofing and walked me through all the steps of the job. He even had the factory rep clear a ventilation question for me where different companies were giving me conflicting information. I also felt it was important to go with an established company that is local. Their price was competitive and was actually the lowest for me, but only by a few hundred dollars. I would have chosen On Tops even if they were a few hundred dollars higher based on the customer service they provided. The prep instructions were clear for me and the install process was very smooth. The workers respected my property. I have only found one nail in the yard since the job was completed. The roof looks great and the copper accent roof over my front windows looks well constructed. The install foreman (Brian) was very personable and knowledgeable. I highly recommend them for roofing work.

reviews.author: max mcveigh
reviews.text: Great service, from Initial enquiry to after the installation of our new roof. We were kept informed at every stage. Work done efficiently and well tidied up afterwards. I would highly recommend On Tops Roofing, my neighbor called them straight after our roof was done, and he's had his done too.

reviews.author: Kim W
reviews.text: We purchased a new roof from On Tops Roofing in 2013. On Tops Roofing did an outstanding job with the initial installation. In and out in one day and done right the first time. We have enjoyed the roof for the past 11 years. In November of 2024, I noticed some discoloration on the ceiling in my master bathroom. Went into the attic and noticed what appeared to be a minor water leak in this area in the roof that had discolored the plywood. I called On Tops Roofing on a Monday to see if they could assess for me. They were able to come out the next day and made recommendations for repairing the leak. In addition, they noticed several other areas that required attention. On December 2, 2024, On Tops Roofing replaced the impacted plywood, resealed and installed new shingles. All of this work was covered under warranty. No charge to me. This is a true example of a company standing behind their work. On Tops has and will continue to be our go-to company for roof related work. When we purchased the initial roof, we did our research and On Tops Roofing stood out as superior. This recent repair demonstrates that they stand behind their work and continue to provide excellent work and customer service. A special shout-out to Chris Talton for supporting us through the initial install and subsequent warranty work. Thank you.

reviews.author: Theodore Walter
reviews.text: Arturo and his team did a fabulous job evaluating the roof and quoting the price . They scheduled the job and were on time and did a great job fixing the vent boot to fix the water leak and replaced the shingles Very professional team!

reviews.author: NICK NICHOLAS
reviews.text: Very pleased with the way it came out and the service received from Luis and his crew was second to none. My neighbor saw the great job done and when I told him about the service he got his done within 3 weeks. In the last 2 months both of my next doors neighbors and my front neighbor have had our roofs done by On Top Roofing.

reviews.author: Jennifer Shewmaker
reviews.text: We were highly impressed from start to finish with On Tops Roofing! Both Jonathan and Josh were very responsive, professional and knowledgable. Their crew did an outstanding job and took pride in their work. On Top went above and beyond our expectations!

reviews.author: Marilee Tingen
reviews.text: We are thrilled with our new roof. The crew did a tremendous job and cleaned up when the job was finished. Josh kept us informed and answered all our questions. This is our second roof with On Tops and we highly recommend them.

reviews.author: Kevin Stewart
reviews.text: I recently used this company for repairs from tropical storm damage to my roof. Jonathan was very easy to work with and kept me informed of what was going on. The cost was very reasonable and I will definitely be using them in the future. If you want an honest and reputable company you will not be disappointed with On tops.

reviews.author: Richard Bodnar
reviews.text: On Tops roofing re-roofed my house after the recent hail storm. The roofers were friendly, efficient and very professional. The project manager, Brian, kept us informed about everything and was quick to respond to our questions and concerns. We could not be happier with the work they did and we highly recommend this company.

reviews.author: Doug Huber
reviews.text: Chris and his site manager Luis did a fantastic job. The price was great, they communicated with us through the whole process, did a great job and were very understanding with the insurance payout timeline.

reviews.author: jeff thomas
reviews.text: OnTops did our roof and we haven't had any issues. They also recently replaced a skylight. They knocked it out within a week of calling. Chris is awesome and you will be taken care of!

reviews.author: Daniel Smith
reviews.text: They did a great job, mainly dealt with Chris and Brian. Both were really professional and everyone with them did a great job. Most importantly they got our insurance claim for hail approved. I would recommend them.

reviews.author: Robert Smith
reviews.text: Company representatives and crew were extremely informative, friendly and professional. Very responsive to my questions and requests throughout the process and cleanup was thorough. Roof looks great and I am completely satisfied.

reviews.author: Rickey Mooney
reviews.text: OnTops and Arturo from OnTops are excellent! They were able to come out and take care of our church's roofing issue quickly and effectively without any mess!

reviews.author: Joe & Nikki Feltenberger
reviews.text: My roof developed a link and needed repair quickly. On Tops was able to repair and was able to find and report two other trouble areas developing. Thankfully we were able to catch those before a more significant problem developed.

reviews.author: Michael Fetting
reviews.text: Always excellent professional advice. I had them come and replace my roof several years back and now I'm having them come and replace my windows. I have no regrets using them and they are trustworthy and honest

reviews.author: Scott Stupak (Scott)
reviews.text: Very responsive. Patient with my questions. Didn't try to sell me something I didn't need. Crew came in and go the job DONE and thoroughly cleaned up after themselves. I'm very satisfied with the results and cost.

reviews.author: Jamie Krantz
reviews.text: On Tops did a great job repairing my roof after we got some storm damage. Everyone was so great at walking us through the process!

reviews.author: Halbert McKinnon
reviews.text: Great job from beginning til finished. We are extremely pleased with the work. Jonathan & Josh top notch.

reviews.author: Helen Magda
reviews.text: They replaced two roofs for me...Patrick was project manager and kept people moving...clean job...left the place immaculate...both roofs look great and they guarantee their work...we are very pleased...would recommend this company

reviews.author: Julia Wooten
reviews.text: Job completed 11 months ago. No problem since then. Worked with insurance company very well. Highly recommend. Pricing reasonable.

reviews.author: Brittany Jones
reviews.text: Thank you On Tops Roofing team for a flawless roof replacement process!! I highly recommend this company.
